declarations.name: distributionParts
declarations.description:
Splits a breakdown into parts: items with no positive value are left out, `sort` orders them, and when `maxItems`
is above zero and there are more, the smallest are folded into one "Other" part, so `maxItems` parts are drawn (at
least two: one kept part and "Other").

One 100% stacked bar that splits a whole into its parts, with a legend underneath: the languages of a repository,
the browsers behind an issue, the statuses of a project's tasks. Each item's segment is as wide as its share of the
total, and the legend lists the items with their shares (or values, or both, with `legend-content`). Hovering a
segment or a legend entry brings that part forward, dims the others and shows its share in a bubble over the bar.

Unlike `c2-meter` it measures nothing against a range: the parts always fill the bar. Tiny parts keep a sliver of
`--c2-distribution-bar__segment--min-width` so they stay visible, and `max-items` folds the smallest into an "Other"
part when there are too many to tell apart.

With `interactive`, each legend entry is a button and each segment clickable, and both fire `item-click`, the way a
tag breakdown filters an issue list by the value clicked.

The bar is one image to a screen reader, named by the label and every part's share. In interactive mode the
legend's buttons carry that instead.

members.name: items
members.description: The breakdown, `{ label, value, color?, key? }` in any unit. Accepts a JSON string as an attribute.

members.name: label
members.description: Label when the default slot is empty.

members.name: sort
members.description: Orders the parts largest first; `none` (the default) keeps the order given.

members.name: maxItems
members.description: Most parts drawn; past it, the smallest items are summed into one "Other" part. `0` (the default) draws every item.

members.name: legendContent
members.description: What each legend entry shows after its label: its `percent` share (the default), its `value`, or `both`.

members.name: precision
members.description: Most decimal places of a share. A share too small to show at it reads "<0.1%".

members.name: interactive
members.description: Makes the legend entries buttons and the segments clickable, both firing `item-click`.

members.name: active
members.description: The part brought forward by the pointer or the keyboard, by key.

members.name: parts
members.description: The parts as drawn: items with a value, sorted and folded as asked.

members.name: formatShare
members.description: A share as text: a percentage in the page's language, at `precision` places, or "<0.1%" for a sliver.

members.name: placeTooltip
members.description: Puts the bubble over the middle of the active segment, kept inside the bar by sliding it along with the segment.

events.name: item-click
events.description: Fired with `interactive` when a segment or a legend entry is activated. `detail` is the part: its `key`, `label`, `value` and `share`, and for "Other" the `items` it sums. Does not bubble.
